m: सं-√ दा P. Ā. -ददाति, -दत्ते, to give together, present, grant, bestow, RV.; AV.; to hold together, AV.; (Ā. or Pass.) to meet, RV. i, 139, 1; iv, 44, 5.
सं-√ दा (or दो) P. -दाति, or -द्यति, to cut together, gather by or after cutting (as the sacrificial grass), KātyŚr.; to cut, divide, AV.
सं-√ दा P. -द्यति, to bind together, fasten together, tie, RV.; AV.; VS.; KātyŚr.
सं-दाह m. burning up, consuming, MW.
inflammation of the mouth and lips, ib.
a: संदाहः — Burning up, consuming.

m: संदामितक w.r. for सं-दानितक.
1. सं-दान n. the act of cutting or dividing, MW.
that part of an elephant's temples whence the fluid called Mada issues (cf. 2. दान), W.
2. सं-दान m. the part under the knee of an elephant where the fetter is fastened (also -भाग), L.
a bond, halter, fetter, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.
a: संदानं — 1 A rope, cord. --2 A chain, fetter. --3 Cutting, dividing. --नः That part of an elephant's temples whence ichor exudes.

m: 2. सं-दान—ता f., Daś.
सं-˚दानिका f. a kind of tree, L.
सं-˚दानिनी f. a cow-house, L.
a: संदानिनी — A cow-pen (गोष्ठ).

m: सं-˚दानित mfn. bound together, tied, fettered, Kāv.
a: संदानित — a. 1 Bound, tied. --2 Fettered, chained.

m: सं-˚दानितक n. a collection of three Ślokas forming one sentence, Naiṣ., Sch.
सं-दातृ mfn. one who ties up or fetters, Mn. viii, 342.
सं-दाव m. flight, retreat, L.
a: संदावः — Flight, retreat.

m: 1. सं-दाय mfn. giving, presenting (in गो-स्˚, q.v.)
2. सं-दाय m. a rein, leash, Hariv.
सं-˚दायिन् mfn. id., Subh.
सं-√ दी (only Impv. -दीदिहि, or -दिदीहि), to shine together, VS.; to bestow by shining, RV.
a: संदी — A small bedstead, cot, couch.

m: सं-दीक्षित mfn. (√ दीक्ष्) consecrated together, KātyŚr., Sch.
सं-दीन mfn. (√ 3. दी) greatly depressed or afflicted, Hariv.
सं-√ दीप् Ā. -दीप्यते (ep. also ˚ति), to blaze up, flame, burn, glow, Hariv. : Caus. -दीपयति, to set on fire, kindle, inflame, RV., &c.; to fire, animate, MBh.; BhP.
a: संदीप् — {c4c} A. To burn or shine very brightly, glow. --Caus. 1 To light, kindle, inflame. --2 To excite, incite, arouse, stimulate.

m: सं-दीपक mfn. inflaming, exciting, making envious or jealous, Gīt.
सं-˚दीपनी (ई), f. (in music) a partic. Śruti, Saṃgīt.
सं-˚दीपन mfn. kindling, inflaming, exciting, arousing, MBh.; Uttarar.
सं-˚दीपन m. N. of one of Kāma-deva's 5 arrows, Vet.
सं-˚दीपन n. the act of kindling or inflaming or exciting (envy &c.), Ṛtus.; Pañcar.
a: संदीपन — a. (नी f.) 1 Kindling, inflaming, exciting; संदीपना एव दुःखस्य प्रियसखीविनोदनोपायाः U. 3. --2 Provoking; U. 4. --नः One of the five arrows of Cupid. --नं 1 Kindling, inflaming. --2 Exciting, stimulating; अनंगसंदीपनमाशु कुर्वते Rs. 1. 12.

m: सं-˚दीपन—वत् mfn. containing inflammable matter, KātyŚr.
सं-˚दीपित mfn. (fr. Caus.) lighted up, kindled, inflamed, excited, Pañcat.; BhP.
सं-दीप्त mfn. inflamed, flaming, burning, being on fire, ŚBr. &c. &c.
a: संदीप्त — p. p. 1 Kindled or inflamed. --2 Excited, stimulated. --3 Instigated, stirred up, prompted.

m: सं-दीप्त—लोचन mfn. one who has inflamed or flashing eyes, Hariv.
सं-दीप्य m. Celosia Cristata, L.
सं-दूषण mfn. (fr. Caus.) corrupting, defiling, Mn. ix, 13
सं-दूषण n. the act of vitiating or corrupting, any vice which causes defilement, Yājñ.
a: संदूषणं — Defiling, corrupting, vitiating.

m: सं-दूषण—कर mf(ई)n. defiling, disgracing (gen.), Hariv.
सं-˚दूषित mfn. (fr. id.) utterly corrupted or vitiated or spoiled, Hariv.
made or grown worse (as a disease), Suśr.
exposed to shame, reviled, abused, MBh.
a: संदूषित — a. 1 Violated, defiled, stained, polluted. --2 Grown worse (as a disease). --3 Abused, censured.

m: सं-√ दंश् P. -दशति, to bite together, seize with the teeth, MBh.; R.; BhP.; to press together, compress, press closely on anything, indent by pressure, MBh.; Kālid.
a: संदंश् — {c1c} P. 1 To bite, sting; संदष्टाधरपल्लवा Amaru. 32. --2 (a) To stick or adhere closely to, cling; उरसा संदष्टसर्पत्वचा Ś. 7. 11; संदष्टवस्त्रेष्वबलानितंबेषु R. 16. 65, 48. (b) To press together, crush by pressure; संदष्टकुसुमशयनानि गात्राणि Ś. 3. 18.

m: सं-दंश m. compression (of the lips), MBh.
too great compression of the teeth in the pronunciation of vowels, RPrāt.
junction, connection, Subh.
a pair of tongs or pincers or nippers, AV.; Br.; Pur.; Suśr.
N. of those parts of the body which are used for grasping or seizing (as the thumb and forefinger together, the opposite eye-teeth, the nippers of a crab &c.), Yājñ.; VarBṛS.; Suśr.; Pañcat.; Kathās.
a partic. Naraka or hell (where the flesh of the wicked is tortured with pincers), Pur.
a chapter or section of a book, Dāyabh.
a partic. Ekāha, Vait.
the site of a village &c. (fixed according to the compass), L.
a: संदंशः — 1 A pair of tongs. --2 Too great compression of the teeth in the pronunciation of vowels (or letters). --3 N. of a hell.

m: सं-˚दंशक m. (or f(इका). ) a pair of tongs or pincers or nippers, small shears or tongs, a vice, Daś.; Amar.
a: संदंशकः — A pair of tongs.

m: सं-˚दंशिका f. biting, pecking (with the beak), Lalit.
a: संदंशिका — A pair of pincers.

m: सं-˚दंशित mfn. armed, mailed, MBh. (B. स-द्˚)
सं-˚दंशित m. a defendant, L.
सं-दशस्य Nom. P. -दशस्यति, to remit, pardon (a sin), RV. iii, 7, 10.
सं-ददस्वस् See सं-√ दस्.
सं-ददि See सं-√ दा, col. 2.
सं-ददि mfn. grasping, comprehending, RV.
सं-दग्ध mfn. burned up, consumed, TS.; &c.

सं-√ दह् P. Ā. -दहति, ˚ते, to burn together, burn up, consume by fire, destroy utterly, RV. &c. &c.; (Ā.) to be burnt up, be consumed, MW. : Pass. -दह्यते, to be burnt up, TS.; to burn, glow, BhP.; to be distressed or grieved, pine away, Ragh. : Caus. -दाहयति, to cause to burn up, MBh. : Desid. See सं-दिधक्षु.
a: संदह् — {c1c} P. To burn; अभिजनः संदह्यतां वह्निना Bh. 2. 39.

m: सं-दलित mfn. (√ दल्) pierced through, pierced, Dhūrtas.
सं-दर्˚भामृत-तोषिणी f. N. of a Comm. on the Mugdhabodha.
सं-दर्भ m. (√ 2. दृभ्; ifc. f(आ). ) stringing or binding together (esp. into a wreath or chaplet), weaving, arranging, collecting, mixing, uniting, Kāv.; Kathās.; Sarvad.
a literary or musical composition, Mcar.; Pratāp.; Mṛcch., Sch.
a: संदर्भः — 1 Stringing together, weaving, arranging. --2 Collection, uniting, mixture; U. 7. 12. --3 Consistency, continuity, regular connection, coherence; संदर्भशुद्धिं गिरां Gīt. 1. --4 Construction. --5 A composition, literary work; रसगंगाधरनामा संदर्भोऽयं चिरं जयतु R. G.; U. 4. --Comp. --विरुद्ध a. irrelevant, incoherent. --शुद्ध a. connected, coherent. --शुद्धिः f. clearness of arrangement (as of a composition).

m: सं-दर्भ—शुद्ध mfn. clearly arranged, coherent, connected, ib.
सं-दर्भ—शुद्धि f. clearness of connection or arrangement (as of the parts of a composition or narrative), regular coherence, Gīt.
सं-दर्भ—चिन्तामणि m. N. of a Comm. on the Śiśupālavadha by Candra-śekhara
सं-दर्भ—ग्रन्थ m. (?) N. of wk. on the worship of Kṛṣṇa
सं-दर्भ—वत् mfn. artificially connected or composed, Harav.
सं-दर्भ—विरुद्ध mfn. contrary to order or consistency, incoherent, unconnected, MW.
सं-˚दर्भित mfn. strung together, arranged, composed, L.
सं-दर्श ˚शन &c. See सं√ दृश्, p. 1144, col. 1.
सं-दर्श m. sight, appearance, MBh.; BhP.
सं-दर्शनी f. (scil. वृत्ति) a partic. manner of subsistence, Baudh.

सं-दर्शन n. the act of looking steadfastly gazing, viewing, beholding, seeing, sight, vision (स्वप्ने संदर्श˚नं-√ गम्, ‘to be seen by or appear to [gen.] in a dream’; ˚नम्प्र-√ यम्, ‘to show one's self to [gen.]’; ˚ने, ‘in view or in the presence of [gen. or comp.]’), Nir.; KātyŚr.; MBh. &c.
a gaze, look, R.; Sāh.
surveying, inspection, consideration, MBh.; Vikr.; Hit.
appearance, manifestation, Kāv.; Sāh.
the rising of a heavenly body with the sun, VarBṛS.
meeting or falling in with (instr. with or without सह), Kathās.; Pañcat. (fr. Caus.) the act of causing to see, showing, displaying, exhibition of or to (comp.), MBh.; R.; Pur.
a: संदर्शनं — 1 Seeing, beholding, viewing. --2 Gazing, looking steadfastly. --3 Meeting, seeing one another. --4 Sight, appearance, vision. --5 Regard, consideration. --6 Showing, displaying.

m: सं-दर्शन—द्वीप m. N. of a Dvīpa, R.
सं-दर्शन—पथ m. the range of sight, Hariv.
सं-दर्शयितृ mfn. (fr. Caus.) causing to see, showing, pointing out, Nir.
सं-˚दर्शित mfn. shown, displayed, manifested, Mālav.
represented, Gīt.
सं-दर्प m. pride, arrogance, boasting of (comp.), Kathās.
सं-√ दस् (only pf. p. P. -ददस्वस्), to die out or become extinguished (as fire), RV. ii, 2, 6 (accord. to Sāy. सं-ददस्वस् = सम्यक्प्रयच्छत्).
सं-दष्˚टाधर mfn. (-पल्लव) id., MBh.; Amar.
सं-दष्˚टौष्ठ mfn. (-पुट) id., MBh.; Amar.
सं-दष्ट mfn. bitten, compressed, pressed closely together, pinched, nipped, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं-दष्ट n. a partic. fault in pronunciation (arising from keeping the teeth too close together), RPrāt.; Pat.
a: संदष्ट — p. p. 1 Bitten. --2 Pressed closely together, crushed. --3 Nipped; pinched. --ष्टं A particular fault in pronunciation.

m: सं-दष्ट—दन्त-च्छद mfn. biting or compressing the lips, MW.
सं-˚दष्टक n. a kind of paronomasia, L.
सं-दष्ट—कुसुम-शयन mfn. indenting (by pressure of the limbs) a couch of flowers, Śak.
सं-दष्ट—ता f. (= संदष्ट n.), RPrāt.
सं-दष्टयमक n. a Yamaka in which each quarter of the stanza begins with a word twice repeated, Bhar.
सं-देघ m. (cf. next) a conglomeration of material elements (said contemptuously of the body), ŚBr.
सं-दे˚शार्थ m. the contents of a message, Megh.
सं-देश m. (ifc. f(आ). ) communication of intelligence, message, information, errand, direction, command, order to (gen. or loc.; -तस् with gen., ‘by order of’), Kauś.; MBh. &c.
a present, gift, L.
a partic. kind of sweetmeat, L.
सं-देश See सं-√ दिस्.
a: संदेशः — 1 Information, news, tidings. --2 A message, an errand; संदेशं मे हर धनपतिक्रोधविश्लेषितस्य Me. 7, 13; R. 12. 63; Ku. 6. 2. --3 Commission, command; अनुष्ठितो गुरोः संदेशः Ś. 5. --Comp. --अर्थः the subject of a message; Me. 5. --वाच् f. a message. --हरः, --हारकः {1} a news-bearer, messenger. {2} an envoy, ambassador.

m: सं-देश—गिर् f. news, tidings, L.
सं-देश—हार mfn. bringing news or tidings, Sāh.
सं-देश—हारक m. (= -हर) (Sāh.)
सं-देश—हारिन् m. (= -हर) (Śak.)
सं-देश—हरा (आ), f. a female messenger, Gal.
सं-देश—हर m. a news-bringer, messenger, envoy, ambassador, Kāv.
सं-˚देशक m. or n. information, news, tidings, Pañcat.
a: संदेशकं — News, tidings.

m: सं-देश—पद n. pl. the words of a message, Ragh.
सं-˚देशित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made to point out, asked to declare, MBh.
सं-˚देश्य mfn. to be directed or instructed, Kathās.
founded on direction or impulse, done on purpose, AV.
belonging to this place, domestic (as opp. to वि-देश्य, ‘foreign’), AV.
सं-देग्धृ mfn. inclined to doubt, L.
सं-दे˚हालंकार m. a partic. figure of speech (cf. above), Sāh.; Pratāp.
सं-दे˚हालंकृति f. a partic. figure of speech (cf. above), Sāh.; Pratāp.
सं-दे˚हापनोदन n. (= -च्छेदन), APrāt., Sch.
सं-देह m. (ifc. f(आ). ) a conglomeration or conglutination (of material elements; see above), ŚBr.; ChUp.
doubt, uncertainty about (gen. loc., or comp.; न or नास्ति संदेहः or संदेहो नास्ति [used parenthetically], ‘there is no doubt, without doubt’), Āpast.; MBh. &c.
(in rhet.) a figure of speech expressive of doubt (e.g. ‘is this a lotus flower or an eye?’), Vām. iv, 3, 11
risk, danger, Kāv.; Pañcat.
सं-देह See सं-√ दिह्.
a: संदेहः — 1 Doubt, uncertainty, suspense; अत्र कः संदेहः. --2 Risk, danger, peril; जीवितसंदेहदोलामारोपितः K.; अर्थार्जने प्रवृत्तिः ससंदेहा H. 1; Pt. 1. 176. --3 (In Rhet.) Doubt regarded as a figure of speech, in which the close resemblance between two objects leads to one of them being mistaken for the other (this figure is also called ससंदेह by Mammaṭa and others); ससंदेहस्तु भेदोक्तौ तदनुक्तौ च संशयः K. P. 10; e. g. see Māl. 1. 2 (l. 3); V. 3. 2. --Comp. --दोला the swing of uncertainty, a state of suspense, dilemma, fix.

m: सं-देह—भञ्जन n. breaking or destroying d˚, Kām.
सं-देह—भञ्जिका f. N. of wk.
सं-देह—भृत् mfn. having d˚ about (loc.), Mcar.
सं-देह—च्छेदन n. cutting i.e. removal of d˚, Kām.
सं-देह—दायिन् mfn. raising d˚ or unc˚ concerning i.e. reminding of (comp.), Vās.
सं-देह—दोला f. the oscillation or perplexity (caused by) d˚, MBh.
सं-देह—दोला-स्थ mfn. ‘one who is in a state of suspense’, Kām.
सं-देह—गन्ध m. a whiff or slight tinge of doubt, MW.
सं-देह—पद mfn. subject to d˚, doubtful, Kālid.
सं-देह—समुच्चय m. N. of wk.
सं-देह—त्व n. state of d˚ or uncertainty, Sāh.
सं-देह—विषौ˚षधि f. N. of wk.
सं-˚देहयान See सं√ दिह्.
सं-˚देहिन् mfn. doubtful, dubious, MW.
a: संदेहिन् — a. 1 Doubtful. --2 Doubting, uncertain, diffident.

m: सं-˚देह्य m. the body (= सं-देह), BṛĀrUp.
सं-˚देष्टव्य mfn. to be informed or instructed, MBh.
to be pointed out or enjoined or communicated, Śak.
सं-˚देष्टव्य n. an injunction, direction, order, MW.

a: संदृभ् — {c6c} P. 1 To string or bind together. --2 To weave together, weave into a bunch or garland. --3 To arrange, connect, compose.

m: सं-√ दृश् P. Ā. (only in non-conj. tenses, e.g. pf. -ददर्श, -ददृशे fut. -द्रक्ष्यति, ˚ते; ind.p. -दृश्य; inf. -द्रष्टुम्, Ved. -दृशे; cf. सम्-√ पश्), to see together or at the same time, see well or completely, behold, view, perceive, observe, consider, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; (Ā. and Pass. -दृश्यते), to be seen at the same time, appear together with (instr.), RV.; ŚBr.; to look like, resemble, be similar or equal, RV.; to be observed, become visible, appear, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -दर्शयति, to cause to be seen, display, show, feign (आत्मानम् मृत-वत् सं-द्˚, ‘to feign one's self dead’), ib.; to represent, Gīt.; Rājat.; to expose, explain, Divyāv.; to show one's self to (acc.), MBh.; R. : Desid. of Caus. See सं-दिदर्शयिषु: Desid. See सं-दिदृक्षु.
सं-दृश् f. (ए dat. as inf.; cf. above) sight, appearance, RV. (सम्यक् पश्यति यः, ‘one who sees well or thoroughly’, Sāy.), AV.; VS.; KaṭhUp.
view, direction, RV. ii, 13, 10.
a: संदृश् — {c1c} P. 1 To see, behold; Bk. 16. 9. --2 To see well or perfectly. --3 To consider, reflect upon. --4 To calculate, enumerate. --5 To overlook, wink at. --Pass. 1 To look like, resemble, be similar. --2 To become visible, appear. --Caus. To show, exhibit, discover; आत्मानं मृतवत्संदर्श्य स्थितः H. 1; Bk. 4. 33; M. 4. 9.

m: सं-˚दृश See मधुसंदृश.
सं-˚दृश्य mfn. to be looked at i.e. appearing as (nom.), MBh.
सं-दृब्ध mfn. strung together, interwoven, bound or collected into a tuft or bunch, ŚBr.
arranged, composed, Naiṣ.
corroborated, confirmed (-त्व n.), Śaṃk.
सं-दृब्ध See p. 1143, col. 1.
सं-दृब्ध—त्व n.
सं-दृष्ट mfn. completely seen or beheld (पाप-स्˚, ‘having an evil aspect’), VarBṛS.
foreseen, ordained, prescribed (in sacred books), R.
सं-दृष्टि f. complete sight, full view, aspect, RV.
सं-˚दृष्टिक w.r. for सांद्˚, Divyāv.
सं-दिधक्षु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to burn up or to consume by fire, MBh.; VarBṛS.; BhP.

सं-√ दिश् P. -दिशति (ind.p. -दिश्य, q.v.), to point out, appoint, assign, R.; Bhaṭṭ.; to state, tell, direct, command, give an order or message to (gen. or dat., sometimes two acc.; with अभि-दूति, ‘to a female messenger’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to despatch any one (acc.) on a message to (dat.), Kum. : Caus. -देशयति, to cause to point out or declare, invite or ask to speak about, MBh.
a: संदिश् — {c6c} P. 1 To give, grant, assign, make over; Bk. 6. 141; Y. 2. 232. --2 To order, direct, instruct, advise, send as a message; किं नु खलु दुष्यंतस्य युक्तरूपमस्माभिः संदेष्टव्यं Ś. 4; Śi. 9. 56, 61. --3 To send as a messenger, entrust with a message; अथ विश्वात्मने गौरी संदिदेश मिथः सखीं Ku. 6. 1. --4 To appoint. --5 To commission or depute in general.

m: सं-दिश्य ind. bidding farewell, Divyāv.
सं-दिदर्शयिषु mfn. (fr. Desid. of Caus.) wishing to show, Bhaṭṭ.
सं-दिदृक्षु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to see, MBh.
सं-दिग्˚धाक्षर mfn. having indistinct utterance, MW.
सं-दिग्˚धार्थ mfn. having doubtful meaning, dubious in sense, ib.
सं-दिग्˚धार्थ m. a doubtful or disputed matter, Yājñ. ii, 12
सं-दिग्˚धी-कृत mfn. made to present a doubtful resemblance, Bālar. vi, 31.
सं-दिग्ध mfn. smeared over, besmeared or covered with (instr. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
confused, confounded with, mistaken for (instr. or comp.), Nir.; Kum.
questioned, questionable, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
precarious, doubtful, dubious, uncertain, unsettled, doubtful about, despairing of (comp.), ib.
riskful, dangerous, unsafe (as a ship), Gaut.
सं-दिग्ध (अम्), n. an ambiguous suggestion or expression, Kpr.; Pratāp.
a: संदिग्ध — p. p. 1 Besmeared, covered. --2 Dubious, doubtful, uncertain; as in संदिग्धमति --बुद्धि &c. --3 Mistaken for or confounded with. --4 Doubted, questioned. --5 Confused, obscure, unintelligible (as a sentence). --6 Dangerous, risky, unsafe. --7 Envenomed. --ग्धं 1 A doubt, uncertainty. --2 Besmearing. --Comp. --अर्थ a. ambiguous, dubious in sense. --(र्थः) {1} an ambiguous or doubtful meaning. {2} a disputed matter. --मति, --बुद्धि a. sceptical, doubtful.

m: सं-दिग्ध—फल mfn. having arrows with poisoned tips (accord. to others ‘of uncertain result or efficacy’), Daś.
सं-दिग्ध—बुद्धि (Śak.) mfn. having a doubtful mind, sceptical
सं-दिग्ध—लेख्य n. a writing or document of doubtful meaning or authority, W.
सं-दिग्ध—मति (Yājñ.) mfn. having a doubtful mind, sceptical
सं-दिग्ध—निश्चय mfn. one who hesitates to hold a firm opinion, R.
सं-दिग्ध—पुनरुक्त-त्व n. uncertainty and tautology, Sāh.
सं-दिग्ध—ता f. (MW.) uncertainty, hesitation, indistinctness
सं-दिग्ध—त्व n. (Sāh.) uncertainty, hesitation, indistinctness

सं-√ दिह् P. -देग्धि, to smear, besmear, cover, Kauś.; MBh. &c.; to heap together, MW.; Ā. -दिग्धे (pr. p. -दिहान, or -देहमान), to be doubtful or uncertain (said of persons and things), Kāv.; Śaṃk. : Pass. -दिह्यते, to be smeared over or covered, be confused, confounded with (instr.), Nir. ii, 7 ; be indistinct or doubtful or uncertain, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -देहयति, to make indistinct or uncertain, confuse, perplex, MBh.; (Ā.) to be doubtful or uncertain (in सं-देहयान v.l. -देहमान), ib.
सं-दिह् f. a heap, mound, wall, RV.
a: संदिह् — {c2c} U. 1 To smear, cover over, anoint. --2 To heap together. --3 To doubt, be uncertain about; Y. 2. 16; संदिग्धो विजयो युधि Pt. 3. 12. --4 To mistake for, to confound with (in pass.); पांतु त्वामकठोरकेतकशिखासंदिग्धमुग्धेंदवः (जटाः) Māl. 1. 2; or धूपैर्जालविनिःसृतैर्वलभयः संदिग्धपारावताः V. 3. 2; Ku. 6. 40. --5 To start an objection. --Caus. 1 To confuse, perplex. --2 To be doubtful or uncertain (Atm.).

m: 1. सं-दित mfn. cut off, cut, MW.
2. सं-दित mfn. bound or fastened together, detained, caught, R.; Hariv.
a: संदित — a. Bound, chained, fettered.

m: सं-दिष्˚टार्थ m. one who communicates information or news, a messenger, herald, pursuivant, W.
सं-दिष्ट mfn. pointed out, assigned &c.
stipulated, promised, Yājñ.
सं-दिष्ट n. news, tidings, information, W.
a: संदिष्ट — p. p. 1 Pointed out, indicated. --2 Assigned. --3 Told, narrated, communicated. --4 Agreed to, promised. --ष्टः One entrusted with a message, a messenger, herald, courier (संदिष्टार्थ also). --ष्टं Information, news, tidings.

m: सं-दिष्ट—वत् mfn. one who has given an order or message, to (gen.; also = pf. सं-दिदेश, ‘he-has given &c.’), Kathās.
सं-दोह m. milking together, milking, Hariv.; BhP.
the whole milk (of a herd), Nār.; Hariv.
totality, multitude, heap, mass, abundance, Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
सं-दोह , ˚हन, ˚ह्या. See सं√ डुह्, col. 1.
a: संदोहः — 1 Milking. --2 The whole quantity of anything, a multitude, heap, mass, assemblage; कुंदमाकंदमधुबिंदुसंदोहवाहिना मारुतेनोत्ताम्यति Māl. 3; Bv. 4. 9.

m: सं-˚दोहन mfn. yielding (as milk), bestowing, Śukas.
सं-˚दोह्या See सुख-संदोह्या.
सं-दोल m. (or f(आ). ) a kind of pendulous ornament, Pañcar.
सं-द्राव m. running together, a place where people run together, Pat. on Pāṇ. v, 1, 119, Vārtt. 5
flight, L.
gait, manner of walking, Bhaṭṭ.
a: संद्रावः — Flight, retreat.

m: सं-द्रव m. flight, L.
सं-द्रष्टव्य mfn. to be seen or sought for, MBh.
सं-˚द्रष्टृ mfn. one who sees well or beholds, Nir.; BhP.
सं-√ द्रु P. -द्रवति, to run together, RV.
सं-दुग्ध mfn. milked at the same time, milked together, MW.

सं-√ दुह् P. Ā. -दोग्धि, -दुग्धे, to milk together or at the same time, MBh.; (Ā.) to suck, imbibe, enjoy, RV. ix, 18, 5; (Ā.) to yield (as milk &c.), AV. : Caus. -दोहयति (ind.p. -दोह्य), to cause to milk &c., ŚBr.
सं-˚दुह्या See सुख-संदुह्या.

सं-√ दुष् P. -दुष्यति, to become utterly corrupt or polluted or unclean, MBh. : Caus. -दूषयति (ind.p. -दूष्य), to corrupt, vitiate, defile, stain, spoil, R.; Suśr.; Rājat.; to revile, abuse, censure, expose to shame or infamy, MBh.; Kām.
a: संदुष् — {c4c} P. To be defiled or stained. --Caus. 1 To defile, pollute, corrupt, soil, taint. --2 To violate. --3 To accuse, censure, find fault with, condemn.

m: सं-दुष्ट mfn. corrupted, defiled &c.
depraved, wicked, bad, R.
ill-disposed, ill-affected towards (gen.), ib.
a: संदुष्ट — p. p. 1 Polluted, defiled. --2 Wicked, depraved. --3 Ill-disposed.
